kind: Automated packaged macOS ARM64 app update from 0.2.0 to 0.3.0 across different bundle paths. A labeled existing simulation fixture exercises all upgrades and 50 helpers; this is not human play, physical-device input, store delivery or performance evidence.

Old app imported the labeled 50-helper/all-upgrade fixture through the file input; actual controls changed every preference and assigned the crew; paused live state matched the canonical save.

0.3.0 launched from a different app bundle using the same isolated profile; all serialized game fields (including 466 dust values, three upgrades, 50 creature records, assignment, elapsed progress and stats) and all settings matched exactly before play resumed.
The upgraded app resumed normal simulation without losing progress or crew direction; migrated controls displayed the saved preferences.
Original 0.2.0 archive hash remained unchanged; both processes quit normally with no observed page errors.
